title: Leashing the Inner Demons: Self-Detoxification for Language Models

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating the toxicity of generated content using the Perspective API by prompting language models with both normal writing prompts (WritingPrompts) and explicitly toxic prompts (RealToxicPrompts).

Measuring the percentage of toxic text generated when the model is prompted with identity-specific natural prompts targeting demographic groups such as 'Asians', 'Jews', and 'Blacks', alongside adversarial triggers.

Calculating the topic coverage rate by matching a predefined list of minority identity mention words within the generated text to assess whether the detoxification method marginalizes or suppresses minority voices.
